CHAPTER 3 · ITEM 01 / 08

Absolute and comparative advantage

Absolute advantage絕對優勢

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Determine absolute advantage from output per unit of input or inputs needed per unit of output.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

同投入比較產量，或同產量比較投入。每小時產量較高或每件所需時間較少的一方有絕對優勢。

Compare output for the same input, or input needed for the same output. The producer making more per hour, or requiring fewer hours per unit, has absolute advantage in that good.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A makes 8 shirts per hour; B makes 5. A has absolute advantage in shirts. 每小時八件高於五件。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A needs 2 hours per table; B needs 3. Who has absolute advantage? 誰有絕對優勢？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
